method: All1117 lines read, pinned Git blob verified. Static settings persistence/UI callbacks review; no Windows/Slint runtime.
findings: Save callback casts signed UI dimensions/font sizes to u32 without range validation; then calls void AppSettings.save and announces hotkey available and saved. Slint control bounds remain unread; invalid persisted settings are not protected by this callback.
Snippet save logs DB failure but clears input fields regardless. Data input can be lost on failed write; delete errors ignored. No real database/inputs modified.

Removing final scan folder saves empty Vec. Previously reviewed get_scan_folders treats empty as defaults, so no-folders cannot be represented this way and UI empty model can disagree with actual scan scope.

AI settings writes use a transaction, narrowing previous separate-write observation for main preset flow. Individual SQL errors and commit errors ignored, so transaction existence alone does not guarantee all fields saved; no failure fixture.

Settings status thread reads each field independently and falls back to Idle/0/Never on errors, conflating DB errors with valid empty/idle state. Persistent DB-open failure exits thread with no retry.

Status thread refreshes every500ms, regenerates and overwrites same QR SVG while server active even if pairing URI unchanged. has_qr true set despite create/write failure; UI later load can fail. No performance or QR rendering test.

Pairing status displays first pending device from map, while approve/reject callbacks snapshot all pending ids and apply to every one. Scope mismatch between displayed single pending record and action target set; sync server implementation and actual UI text remain unread. No pairing action executed.

Settings instance mutex successful handle is not stored or closed in function, intentionally surviving process life but no explicit ownership guard; duplicate settings launch returns without focusing existing window.

Folder picker spawns thread then blocks calling UI thread on recv; dialog uses no owner. COM uninitialization unconditional despite ignored init result, and returned display-name allocation is not freed in read code. No dialog run.
DISPLAY_VERSION hardcoded1.0.0 rather than package version, an explicit compact label choice; not evidence of installed version or update state. No original test block exists in this module.
limits: 87/268 whole files; repository013 incomplete, Slint markup and sync modules remain unread.
No new tests or production modifications.
